paraphrase: Scott's theorem T3 (AFP GoedelGod.thy): necessarily a God-like being exists, that is, at every world every accessible world has a God-like individual. Existence is the possibilist quantifier of the embedding (DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY), and God-like is Scott's G (DEF-GOD-LIKE-SCOTT), not the corpus's God or IsGod.
